payload.title: papyrus references add: import a Reference from a URL (and link it to a story) in one command
payload.description:
Rough edge found 2026-10-30 while recording the sources for the Data Parade story on cli-login (43 URLs).

What happened: the CLI has no simple way to turn a URL into a Reference. The only intake path is the GraphQL mutation intakePendingReferences, which allows editor groups only (no IAM operator lane) and takes 1 to 20 items as AWSJSON, so an operator or agent has to script find_or_create_source_reference (src/papyrus_content/reference_intake.py) by hand: find the corpus id, fetch each page title, call the function, then call link_reference_to_story. Stories already have link-reference, but there is nothing to create the Reference first.

Proposal:
- papyrus references add <url> [<url> ...] [--file urls.txt] [--title <text>] [--rationale <text>] [--story <lineage> --role consulted|cited|based_on] [--dry-run].
- Writes by default like other mutation commands; --dry-run shows new versus existing.
- Reuses find_or_create_source_reference (dedupes by canonical URL within the corpus, creates pending References with provenance and a preview image).
- Resolves the site's corpus itself.
- Fetches the page title when --title is not given; falls back to the URL and never fails the batch on one bad fetch.
- Retries transient network errors.
- Works in both lanes: user session and IAM.

Acceptance:
- Gherkin scenarios: add one URL; add a file of URLs, some already present (reused, not duplicated); add and link to a story with a role; a title fetch fails (URL used as title); --dry-run writes nothing.
- Documented in the CLI docs and on p.apyr.us.
